scope: Meaning of the retained zoom-pupil coordinates; not a new fitted degree of freedom

sources.title: Ansys Optics: Paraxial vs. Real pupils in optical system
sources.supports: Entrance pupil is the optical image of the aperture stop; its position is distinct from the physical stop and can change with the optical configuration.

sources.title: Edmund Optics: Telecentric Design Topics
sources.supports: Entrance pupil is the stop image in object space; physical lens-element positions and entrance-pupil position are different quantities.

model_meaning.vertical_lever: Off-axis height between the tilt-axis reference and the optical axis, chosen upward8cm from compact visible assembly.
model_meaning.forward_reference: Projection-centre position along the camera optical axis at the recorded focal reference. Fixed +5cm as a selected reference constraint; it is not an independently fitted solid arm.
model_meaning.pupil_terms: Linear/quadratic change of the effective axial projection centre relative to that reference. Their sum with the reference is the quantity evaluated over the entire joined observed focal span.
model_meaning.readout: One shared effective monotone row-time span in the selected three-camera working model, not a measurement of original capture mode.

decisions.constant_centre_branch: Rejected from visible S07 advertising drift; source-required zoom-pupil variation retained.
decisions.reference_branch: Initial full-source projection preserved to numerical roundoff while removing three independent forward-reference coordinates.
decisions.working_forward_interval_status: Explicit engineering guard for this programme model. It is not measured from the Sony body outline, and the pupil is not a piece of hardware that must lie at a visible screw or inside the housing.
